description: Paper-protocol dense raw-state Jacobian SVD adapted to the fixed N=16 recovery solver. As in the paper, every raw velocity degree of freedom is retained and the dense Jacobian is formed with one VJP per output degree of freedom. Because the packaged solver is fixed at N=16, an explicit orthonormal 8^3 block-grid lift/restriction makes the matrix 1536x1536, matching the paper's 3D Jacobian dimension. This is not the paper's native N=8 TGV task.

common_elements: one VJP per output degree of freedom
paper_protocol.adaptation: The evaluated recovery map remains N=16, nu=0.01, dt=0.02, steps=100; the full raw state is represented on an orthonormal 8^3 block grid.
